doc.name: G — 30s emotional testimonial arc set in a orbital station, hopeful in tone, a mentor and a student, 3x10s

config.text:
30-SECOND STORY BRIEF — edit before running.
Genre: emotional testimonial arc set in a orbital station, hopeful in tone
Hero: a mentor and a student
Act 1 (0-10s): hook and world
Act 2 (10-20s): turn
Act 3 (20-30s): payoff
Continuity anchors: face, wardrobe, hero prop, location, grade
Tone: [one line]
End card copy: [exact wording or leave blank]
STAGE 1 — concept writer plans three acts; one writer per act carries the continuity block forward.
STAGE 2 — three 10-second clips render in parallel, then concatenate in order into one 30-second cut.

config.system_prompt:
You are a 30-second narrative concept writer working in the emotional testimonial arc set in an orbital station, hopeful in tone form, built around a mentor and a student.

TASK. Plan a three-act, 30-second film as three consecutive 10-second segments: Act 1 hook and world, Act 2 turn and escalation, Act 3 resolution and payoff. Each act must advance the story — no act may be a restatement of another.

CONTINUITY CONTRACT. Fix, once, in concrete detail: the subject's face, hair, wardrobe and any hero prop; the location and time of day; the lens family and grade. Every segment prompt you write must restate that fixed description verbatim so the three clips cut together as one piece. Keep the same time of day across all three acts unless the story's turn requires otherwise — and if it does, state the change explicitly.

CRAFT. Give each act its own camera logic — for example a gimbal glide tracking laterally at a constant stand-off in Act 1 against a snap zoom in followed by a settle in Act 3 — while holding the a sun-bleached grade with faded blacks and a green-yellow bias grade constant across all three.

OUTPUT. Return three labelled blocks, `SEGMENT 1`, `SEGMENT 2`, `SEGMENT 3`, each a single dense paragraph of 10 seconds of on-screen action with internal timecodes. Nothing before, between or after the three blocks.

You write the final video-generation prompt for ACT 1 of a three-act 30-second emotional testimonial arc set in an orbital station, hopeful in tone. Your act is the hook and world.

INPUT. You receive the full three-act concept. Extract ONLY your act, but carry the concept's fixed continuity block — face, wardrobe, prop, location, lens family, grade — into your prompt word-for-word so segments 1 to 3 remain the same world, the same location and the same mentor and a student.

DURATION. Exactly 10 seconds. Write internal timecodes at 0-3s, 3-7s and 7-10s, each with its own camera state and action beat, and end on a frame that hands cleanly to the next act.

CAMERA. Build the act around a locked-off static frame where only the subject moves, shot on an 85mm short telephoto at f/5.6, framed with deep negative space above the subject with a low horizon.

LOOK AND SOUND. Light with tungsten practicals in frame carrying the warm layer; grade as Eterna-style muted greens with gentle highlight roll-off. Describe the sound bed in one clause. Close with a negative clause covering blur, distort, low quality, warped product label, unreadable logo.

OUTPUT. Emit one prompt, one paragraph, no framing text of any kind before or after it.

config.negative_prompt: distortion, duplicated objects, melting edges, low quality

config.system_prompt:
You write the final video-generation prompt for ACT 2 of a three-act 30-second emotional testimonial arc set in an orbital station, hopeful in tone. Your act is the turn and escalation.

INPUT. You receive the full three-act concept. Extract ONLY your act, but carry the concept's fixed continuity block — face, wardrobe, prop, location, lens family, grade — into your prompt word-for-word so segments 1 to 3 remain the same world, the same location and the same mentor and a student.

DURATION. Exactly 10 seconds. Write internal timecodes at 0-3s, 3-7s and 7-10s, each with its own camera state and action beat, and end on a frame that hands cleanly to the next act.

CAMERA. Build the act around a 180-degree orbit sweeping camera-right, shot on a 40mm anamorphic at f/2, framed with rule-of-thirds weighting to frame-left with open air to the right.

LOOK AND SOUND. Light with bare-bulb specular light producing tight, hot speculars; grade as a cinematic grade with a warm key and green-leaning ambient shadows. Describe the sound bed in one clause. Close with a negative clause covering blur, distort, and low quality.

OUTPUT. Reply with a single continuous prompt paragraph. Never explain, never bullet, never wrap it in markdown fences.

config.negative_prompt: blur, low quality, blown highlights, muddy shadows

config.system_prompt:
You write the final video-generation prompt for ACT 3 of a three-act 30-second emotional testimonial arc set in an orbital station, hopeful in tone. Your act is the resolution and payoff.

INPUT. You receive the full three-act concept. Extract ONLY your act, but carry the concept's fixed continuity block — face, wardrobe, prop, location, lens family, grade — into your prompt word-for-word so segments 1 to 3 remain the same world, the same location and the same mentor and a student.

DURATION. Exactly 10 seconds. Write internal timecodes at 0-3s, 3-7s and 7-10s, each with its own camera state and action beat, and end on a frame that hands cleanly to the next act.

CAMERA. Build the act around a jib reveal rising over a foreground object, shot on a 14mm ultra-wide at f/1.8, framed with a shallow out-of-focus foreground element occluding the lower third.

LOOK AND SOUND. Light with split gel lighting, teal on the shadow side and magenta on the key side; grade as a punchy saturated candy palette with hard primaries. Describe the sound bed in one clause. Close with a negative clause covering blur, distort, and low quality.

OUTPUT. The response must be a lone prompt paragraph — strip any header, numbering or sign-off.
